scientific_limitations_and_integrity: New results are an annealed, uniform-in-time path coupling, its exact logarithmic-error order for fixed p>1/2, and near-critical process and occupation limits. The dyadic Markov structure, binary representation, and standard Brownian invariance principle are prior mathematical ingredients. Uniform initial coordinates and fresh independent branch choices are essential; no quenched claim is made. Unindexed equivalent strong couplings remain a priority risk; all finite checks are supportive rather than proofs.
title: An optimal logarithmic path coupling for the Pelikan map and its critical-window occupation law
